mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAYP0007.retrievePayrollItemPropertyList */ ccc.common_code AS payroll_calc_method_code , cccm.common_code_name AS payroll_calc_method_name , pcm.payroll_apply_flag FROM tb_pay_calc_mthd_n pcm , lgcom_common_code_c ccc , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm WHERE pcm.payroll_item_id = #{payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ccc.code_type_code = 'LGDVH_PAY_ITEM_METHOD_CODE' AND cccm.code_type_code = ccc.code_type_code AND cccm.common_code = ccc.common_code AND ccc.common_code = pcm.payroll_calc_method_code AND cccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} ORDER BY ccc.sort_order_no
mapper.update: UPDATE /* LGVPAYP0007.updatePayrollItemProperty */ tb_pay_calc_mthd_n SET payroll_apply_flag = #{payrollApplyFlag} /* 급여적용여부 */ WHERE payroll_item_id = #{payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여항목아이디 */ AND payroll_calc_method_code = #{payrollCalcMethodCode} /* 급여산출방법코드 */
